content: घोषः [घुष्-भावे घञ्] .²1 Noise, tumult, cry or sound in general; स घोषो घार्तराष्ट्राणां हृदयानि व्यदारयत् <ls>Bg. 1. 19</ls>; so रथ˚, तूर्य˚, शङ्ख˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 The thundering of clouds; स्निग्ध गम्भीरघोषम् <ls>Me. 64</ls> (<ab>v. l.</ab>). .²3 Proclamation. .²4 Rumour, report; दुःशासुरागादिति घोष आसीत् <ls>Rv. 10. 33. 1</ls>. .²5 A herdsman; see घोषवृद्ध below. .²6 A hamlet, station of cowherds; <ls>Bhāg. 5. 5. 30</ls>; विहारभूमेरभिघोषमुत्सुकाः <ls>Ki. 4. 31</ls>; गङ्गायां घोषः <ls>K. P. 2</ls>; घोषादानीय <ls>Mk. 7</ls>. .²7 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) The soft sound heard in the articulation of the soft consonants; <ls>Rv. Pr. 13. 5</ls>. .²8 A Kāyastha (one of the writer class). .²9 A vowel. .²10 A gnat, mosquito. .²11 An epithet of Śiva. .²12 Recitation, the sound of prayers; सदसि निबिडचैत्यब्रह्मघोषैः पुरस्तात् <ls>Mk. 10. 12</ls>. .²13 An ornament that makes a tinkling sound; घोषप्रघोषरुचिरम् <ls>Bhāg. 10. 8. 22</ls>. .{@-षम्@} Bell-metal.
